nodes.label: Keeping the phone responsive during long tickets
nodes.rationale: Every room poll and menu reread repainted the whole dish list and every price built its own Intl.NumberFormat, so on a cheap phone taps queued up and landed on an already changed screen. Now unchanged responses are skipped and unchanged orders keep their objects, menu rows are memo, formatters are cached, headers are solid instead of blurred, double tap never zooms, the category strip scrolls only itself instead of scrollIntoView, and Ordina and the menu window survive a poll that no longer contains the table.

nodes.label: Status header and queue sheet (no banner)
nodes.rationale: No banner, because an appearing box shifts the page and the next tap lands on the dish above; the existing header turns amber and its second line reads e.g. "Senza collegamento al PC · 2 comande in attesa", opening a list with Riprova, Rimetti in comanda and Elimina. Check-changing actions without the PC warn immediately instead of freezing ten seconds.

nodes.label: Connection detection and /api/health probe (connection.ts)
nodes.rationale: Any response, even a refusal, means the PC is there; no response means it is not. When missing, the phone polls GET /api/health on :3003 every 5 s with the screen on and flushes the queue and rereads the room as soon as it answers; at startup with a saved login it shows "Collegamento al PC..." instead of the login form, and login tells an unreachable PC from wrong credentials.

nodes.label: Server App proxy allowlist (main/server-app.ts)
nodes.rationale: Forwards to :3001 only the listed GET/POST/PATCH/PUT routes and answers 404 for anything else under /api (before, an unknown route fell into the static fallback and returned the page HTML with 200). The role is checked twice: by the proxy, which admits only server, and by the main API behind every forward.

nodes.label: Handheld has no cash, table writes, customers or takeaway
nodes.rationale: Bills, payments, voids, discounts and line prices stay on the central PC beside the till, and the proxy does not forward those routes; tables (status, reservations, map) are written only from the PC while the handheld reads GET /tables and GET /rooms. No customer fields (reservations carry their own name and party size) and no takeaway or delivery: a phone in the dining room takes table orders.

nodes.label: Unauthenticated product image passthrough with ETag
nodes.rationale: An cannot carry a token; the main API already leaves the same route open (main/server.ts) on all interfaces, so the passthrough only brings the bytes onto the page origin allowed by its CSP (img-src 'self' data:). Bytes pass as bytes with ETag/304, read-only, 404 when the Server App is off, the main API alone decides the allowed formats (never SVG), and dot-only ids are rejected because they would vanish from the forwarded URL.

nodes.label: Back button through browser history (handheld-history.ts)
nodes.rationale: The Android edge gesture used to leave the page. Table, Ordina and the open ticket are history entries: back closes ticket to menu, menu to table, table to Sala, and leaves only from Sala. Entries are pushed only from a tap (Chrome skips those added without) and through Next's pushState so they carry its __NA marker, without which Next reloads; windows over a screen are not in history.

nodes.label: Queue retry policy by response class
nodes.rationale: No answer or 408/425/429/502/503/504 retries by itself; 401 after the new login; other 5xx after 10, 30 and 60 seconds and then asks the waiter; any other 4xx asks at once with the reason (check closed, table gone, dish sold out, refusal). An entry is sent only with the token of the waiter who wrote it, since the backend keys idempotency per account.

nodes.label: 30-minute auto-send limit (Invia lo stesso)
nodes.rationale: Owner's choice: a starter reaching the kitchen three quarters of an hour later is expected by nobody, so past 30 minutes the waiter decides with Invia lo stesso, which reuses the same key.

nodes.label: Dishes go back to the cart only when the PC surely lacks them
nodes.rationale: Only when the entry never left or the PC refused it with a 4xx; after a timeout or a 5xx it may already be on the check, so putting it back would risk a dish sent twice.

nodes.label: TableScreen (full page table view with pending tickets)
nodes.rationale: A full page with a back arrow replaced the drawer, which had no close button and had to be unmounted whenever the menu window opened on the same layer. No service-run selector inside a fixed menu: courses already order the runs.

nodes.label: Every waiter on every table (ownership constraint dropped)
nodes.rationale: The handheld taking the main course is not the one that took the starter, so the seven ownership guards in main/routes/orders.ts and main/routes/index.ts were dropped on handheld and PC; per-route requireRole stays (a waiter still cannot discount, reprice or cash), and orders.user_id is still stamped from the token, never the body.

nodes.label: Il palmare (Server App)
Derived append-target order
nodes.rationale: The order the cart appends to is read fresh from the cart's table on every render, so switching table cannot send a round to the wrong check (lesson of commit ffb52ad on the PC).

nodes.label: Ticket saved on the phone (handheld draft)
nodes.rationale: A phone loses in-memory state more easily than a till (reload, tab discarded by the browser, iPhone relaunching the app). Cart and open menu window are saved per waiter on every change (batched 300 ms) and immediately on backgrounding; within half an hour it reopens straight onto the ticket and menu window, up to 12 hours the Sala offers Apri / Scarta. Restoring does not refresh its time, a draft already queued never returns as unsent, and the PC cart store is untouched.

nodes.label: POS windows mounted unchanged (AddonModal, FixedMenuPicker, AttachToMenuModal, ServiceRunPicker)
nodes.rationale: The windows were written props-in/callbacks-out on components/ui/modal (bottom sheet under 768 px) so they mount on the handheld untouched, together with the pure libs and the shared UI primitives; tenant-format.ts seeds currency and country into the auth store so useFormatCurrency formats in euro inside them.

nodes.label: useHandheldData polling (catalogue, settings, rooms, open orders)
nodes.rationale: Polls every 15 s while visible and leaves state untouched when the response text is unchanged; rows come from GET /orders rather than from tables, because rows tell whether a round is pending.

nodes.label: Handheld web manifest and safe-area layout
nodes.rationale: The route layout declares viewport-fit=cover and its own public/server-app.webmanifest starting from /server-standalone instead of the till, so added to the home screen it opens on the room; header and action bar keep clear of notch and home indicator with env(safe-area-inset-*).

nodes.label: Interrupted send replay through the send queue
nodes.rationale: Key and body are written on the phone before the request leaves and every repeat resends them identical; the backend answers with what it already did. The order to open or append to is decided at the tap and only the backend changes it (409 on an already open table).

nodes.label: Known limits of the handheld (Cosa resta fuori)
nodes.rationale: Two waiters on the same menu: the PUT is last-writer-wins. The till can still open a second order on an occupied table, since only the handheld sends only_if_table_free. The handheld token expires at a fixed time (10 days with Ricordami, 24 h without) and is not renewed, though ticket and queue survive. The PC keeps the same single-attempt trap in append-attempt.ts. The cart estimate excludes the cover charge, which the backend computes.

nodes.label: Kitchen ticket per order at end of queue round (45 s timeout)
nodes.rationale: The kitchen ticket leaves at the end of the round, one per order, from a list saved with the queue, so two waiting rounds of a table print on one sheet; without network the order stays listed for the next round and a printer error gives the usual warning. 45 s because an unplugged network printer costs 5 s per station and a USB one on Windows up to 20.

nodes.label: Legacy send attempts adopted into the queue
nodes.rationale: Attempts left by the previous version (buonapp:server-app-order-attempt and the waiter's append-attempt key) enter the queue on first start with their own key, so an interrupted send from before the upgrade is neither lost nor doubled.

nodes.label: OrdinaView product list (photo, pencil, stepper) and full-screen ticket
nodes.rationale: A list of rows replaced the two-column tile grid on 2026-09-24 because the eye jumped between names; a taller row reads at a glance. The search got an x that clears it while keeping the keyboard open.

nodes.label: Sala view (table list per room, natural order, status band and pill)
nodes.rationale: A list rather than the map: on a six-inch screen a scaled room shrinks and scrolls sideways, and a waiter standing at the table does not need its position. Status is shown twice (coloured band and written pill) because the old dot was not visible in passing.

nodes.label: Send queue (coda d'invio) on the phone
nodes.rationale: Before, an interrupted send left a single pending attempt per waiter (lib/append-attempt.ts) and every later send, on any table, failed until a reload that threw the ticket away. Now Invia writes the ticket into a queue on the phone that sends it immediately or by itself when the link returns, one entry at a time and in order within each table, while a waiting table does not block the others.

nodes.label: Server App tableside handheld (:3003, buonapp.local)
nodes.rationale: Until 5.0.0 it kept FloCafe's features (product grid, one note per line, send); the PC windows were written props-in/callbacks-out so they could be mounted here untouched. Rebuilt 2026-09-15, restyled 2026-09-16, made reliable 2026-10-08 after two service reports (phone losing the Wi-Fi and a long 20-cover ticket lost on reload).

nodes.label: ServerAppAccess QR codes (sidebar "Palmari" and Settings)
nodes.rationale: Moved into the PC sidebar item "Palmari" (a modal over the current screen, so a half-taken order survives) so a cashier, who cannot see Settings, can show it to a new waiter; the QR is only an address and the waiter's credentials are still required. Hidden when server_app_enabled is off; Settings now shows the codes immediately.

nodes.label: What to check when the phone loses the Wi-Fi
nodes.rationale: The handheld now survives a network gap but the network still needs care. In order: phone switching to mobile data (adaptive Wi-Fi / Wi-Fi Assist), Wi-Fi off while the screen sleeps and battery optimisation, PC changing address (reserve a DHCP address, the QR points to it, not every phone resolves buonapp.local), PC sleeping or powering down its network card and a non-private network letting the firewall close ports 3001-3003, coverage (repeater or mesh with the same SSID). Without HTTPS no service worker registers, so a reload while the PC is mute shows the browser error page.

nodes.label: Backend decides who opens the table (only_if_table_free, 409 table_has_open_order)
nodes.rationale: If the table was opened meanwhile (another handheld, the till, an earlier ticket of the same phone) the 409 names the open order and proves nothing was written under that key; the same dishes go onto it as an append with key <key>:a, without covers or notes, and the waiter is told when another device opened it.

nodes.label: Products without options go straight to the ticket (lib/product-options.ts)
nodes.rationale: Water has nothing to decide, and a window for every dish was an extra tap all evening; the pencil still opens note and quantity. Fixed menus, dishes fitting a free course of an open menu and dishes with add-ons or open price still open their window.

nodes.label: Queue entry frozen at the tap (idempotency key, address, body)
nodes.rationale: Every repeat resends the same key, address and body; the backend keeps every answered key (order_idempotency, no expiry) and replays its answer before any other check, also for a new order since 2026-10-08, because a dish disabled meanwhile made it answer 400 to an order that existed.

nodes.label: Handheld never imports @/lib/api
nodes.rationale: The PC API client's 401 interceptor would send the handheld back to the PC login; the handheld uses its own server-api.ts client and writes only the currency into the PC auth store already in the bundle.

nodes.label: Row stepper counts only standalone dishes
nodes.rationale: A dish chosen inside a fixed menu belongs to the menu; until 2026-09-24 it was counted too, leaving rows selected with a minus that could not remove them. The minus undoes a wrong tap without opening the ticket (plain line first, else the last line of that dish) and is disabled when nothing is removable; the menu row's minus stays off because a menu is removed from the ticket.

hyperedges.label: Handheld screens as browser history entries (Sala, table, Ordina)
Three queue rules that stop a dish being sent twice
